_note: Estates, like EU4. Every nation has these three. loyalty (0-100) drifts toward 50, plus 15 while the estate holds its privilege. influence is 20, plus 35 with the privilege. Loyal estates (60+) give their bonus, disloyal ones (under 30) their malus. An estate with 50+ influence and under 30 loyalty disrupts the realm (stability -1, at most once every two years). Granting the privilege gives the crown its modifiers too; revoking it costs 50 of the first power type. Calling on an estate (once every ten years) gives its support and costs 15 loyalty.
